sources.title: Aetna 2025 Prior Authorization Metrics
sources.access: Official PDF fully inspected through browser PDF extraction; physical pages 1-2 checked; physical page 1 is viewer P0, page 2 is P1.
sources.finding: H0523: standard approved 97.61%, denied 2.39%, approved after appeal 53.33%; expedited approved 97.06%, denied 2.94%; extension approval N/A. Mean elapsed receipt-to-determination 3.06 days standard / 0.54 expedited; median 0 days for each.

sources.title: CMS Interoperability and Prior Authorization Final Rule CMS-0057-F
sources.access: Official CMS fact sheet full page inspected.
sources.finding: Expedited 72-hour and standard 7-calendar-day PA decision deadlines generally begin Jan 1 2026 for impacted payers, with QHP issuers on FFEs excluded from these decision-timeframe requirements. PA policies under this rule exclude drug decisions. These are deadlines, not expected/observed processing durations.

sources.title: You have rights in an emergency room under EMTALA
sources.access: Official CMS page full section inspected, lines on screening, insurance inquiry, stabilization and transfer.
sources.finding: Insurance may be asked at check-in only when it does not delay screening or treatment; uninsured patients must still be offered screening. CMS page states screening, stabilization and appropriate transfer protections.

sources.title: Aetna Precertification overview
sources.access: Official Aetna provider page full overview inspected.
sources.finding: Aetna distinguishes notification (data entry without coverage judgment) from coverage determination (plan terms and, where applicable, clinical review); precertification is not a payment guarantee.

sources.title: The effect of discharge destination and primary insurance provider on hospital discharge delays among patients with traumatic brain injury: a multicenter study of 1,543 patients
sources.access: Original open-access full text inspected via NCBI PMC BioC JSON.
sources.finding: Of 1,543 adult TBI patients, 210 had discharge delay >=24h after readiness was documented; among delayed cases, insurance authorization cited 109/210 (51.9%, published as 52%), overlapping with other barriers.

corrections: Added H0523 approved-after-appeal 53.33% and extension approval N/A; clarified no request/appeal denominators in table.
Corrected CMS setting, canonical source URL, operational compliance date scope, FFE QHP deadline exclusion, drug exclusion, and stated deadlines are policy limits rather than durations.
Sharpened EMTALA boundary to no delay of exam/treatment and screening even when uninsured.
Added measured post-acute insurance-authorization delay finding with exact denominator and overlapping-reason caveat.
Verified the earlier behavioral-health PES reported percentages conflict with article count totals; original published percentages are preserved and numeric calibration withheld pending resolution.
luna_use_boundary: Luna may explain sourced workflow rules, identify missing plan documents, and route administrative follow-up; do not infer member-specific coverage/payment or delay EMTALA emergency screening/treatment.
